fullContent:
Sutikabharana Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Ayurved Sarsangrah, edition 17, page no: 401-402 
 Sutikabharana Rasa is an ayurvedic medicine given to women to cure the post – delivery problems like puerperal sepsis. This medicine balances the tridoshas – vata, pitta and kapha in body. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Swarna bhasma 
 Raupya bhasma 
 Tamra bhasma 
 Praval bhasma 
 Shudh parad (Purified Mercury) 
 Shudh gandhak (Purified Sulphur) 
 Abharak bhasma 
 Shudh hartal 
 Shudh manshil 
 Sonth (Dry ginger) Zingiber officinale 
 Kali marich – black pepper – Piper nigrum 
 Peepal 
 Kutki  
 Milk of aak ( Calotropis procera) 
 Chitrak Moolchal 
 Punarnava 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Firstly kajali is prepared and then make the powder of ingredients from 1-13 and triturate it with decoction or juice of each ingredient from 14-16 for one day and tablets are made. 
 Properties of Sutikabharana Rasa 
 Sutikabharana Ras is an amazing combination of herbal and mineral ingredients. It is formulated to manage the post-delivery problems like puerperal sepsis in females. This medicine helps to manage the bacterial infections of the female reproductive tract after baby birth. Natural ingredients used in the formulation of this medicine are packed with the anti-microbial properties which help to eliminate the microorganisms from uterus and surrounding area. Besides of this, Sutikabharana Ras also helps to manage the symptoms associated with puerperal infections like fever, chills, feelings of discomfort or illness, pain in the lower abdomen or pelvis due to swollen uterus, foul-smelling vaginal discharge, headache, loss of appetite, increased heart rate etc. 
 Indications 
 This medicine is given to treat the post-delivery problems like puerperal sepsis. 
 Dosage 
 1/2 – 1 tablet of 125 mg twice in a day or as directed by Ayurvedic physician. 
 Side effects 
 Take this medicine only under medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
